svg.text: Local + selected published evidence. A tested slice is not a whole-language safety certificate.
R = related canonical core H = host / different role X = private | Every cell has notes and source navigation in atlas.html

chapeliser / interpreter: PR 71 repairs cwd and compiler-probe failures. Regression tests cover independent failed chpl/zig probes and real build-shell exit handling; not full Chapel/Zig target certification.
